section.catchline: County assessor duties to provide assessment data -- Commission review -- Subscription to market data service.
section.subsection:
As used in this section, "assessment data" means:
the information described in Subsection 59-2-303.1(6) contained in a county's database used in mass appraisal; and any other assessment information the commission requires.

The commission may:
review a county's annual update of property values the county is required to perform under Section 59-2-303.1; review a county's detailed review of property characteristics the county is required to perform under Section 59-2-303.1; and provide findings and recommendations to the county.

The commission may subscribe to a market data service to assist:
the commission in performing a review described in Subsection (3); and counties in meeting the requirements of Section 59-2-303.1.
